title.value: ON THE MODELING CAPABILITIES OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR SEQUENTIAL DECISION MAKING

analysis.description: This paper explores the abilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to handle reinforcement learning (RL) tasks in interactive domains. It evaluates LLMs' capacity to generate decision-making policies, either directly by producing actions or indirectly by generating reward models to train an RL agent. The study highlights the exceptional reward modeling capabilities of LLMs and discusses the enhancement of this aspect through AI feedback and fine-tuning with synthetic data.
